g.text: Jane Fonda ‘Didn’t Dare Imagine’ Democrats’ Blue Tsunami: ‘We Have to Block What’s Bad and Fight For What’s Good’ ◆ Pamela Abdy Delivers Fiery Speech After Warner Bros Exit: ‘It is Getting Harder, Not Easier, to be a Woman in the Business’ ◆ Taiwan Creative Content Fest Opens as Chair Sue Wang Says ‘Culture Is Power’ Amid AI Shift ◆ ‘Lord of the Rings,’ ‘Avatar’ VFX House Weta FX Partners With Taiwan’s Moonshine Studio Under AI Pact With TAICCA ◆ ‘Pout-Pout Fish’ Studio Like a Photon Creative Unveils Seven-Film Animation Slate With Sola Media, Ahead of AFM (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ Jalen Brunson Makes ‘Law & Order: SVU’ Acting Debut as a Promoted Cop: ‘I Focused on My Goals… Things Worked Out’ ◆
